U1.pre_text: How often should the database be backed up, and how many should we keep?

U2.pre_text: How should users hear about finished jobs: email, in-app, or both?

U3.pre_text: Any constraints on the storage stack?
U3.text: Use Postgres for everything. No Redis.

U4.pre_text: Should the CLI remember the login between runs, or ask every time?
U4.text: Remember it. I don't want to type a password every time.

U6.text: Only me, typed into a popup. No agent ever sees it.

U7.pre_text: Which model should review claims by default?
U7.text: Local gemma by default. Haiku only as a second opinion.

U8.pre_text: Any limits on export size or speed?
U8.text: Not that I know of. Just don't make it slow.

new_statements.text: We can use Redis for the cache after all.
Exports should also be available as XLSX.
Make the login expire after a week.

new_statements.pre_text: Reviewer results look good. Keep the setup?
new_statements.text: Use Haiku as the default reviewer from now on.

new_statements.pre_text: The CSV parser fix is in. Anything else?
What should the settings page have?
new_statements.text: The settings page needs a dark mode.

new_statements.pre_text: Is the backup schedule still right?
new_statements.text: Every night is fine, but also take one before each deploy.

new_statements.pre_text: Do exports have a time limit?
Bootstrapping needs an admin password. How?
new_statements.text: The planner can set the admin password when bootstrapping.
Run the reviewer on my GPU box.
